name: LabelCollection - Remove Control Revealed
description: Hovering one saved row of a collapsed group reveals that row's per-row action bar, and only that row's -- the pin/edit controls are gated on `showActions || hover || expanded` in Url, so they appear under the cursor and nowhere else. The remove control is the deliberate exception: `showRemove` is not hover-gated, so the X sits on every row whether or not it is hovered. It un-files the page from the group and nothing more, raising exactly one confirm about the group and never offering to delete the page from history. Captured on the phantom-members group so the control is shown against the rows it is most likely to be used on. This scenario runs on the COLLAPSED variant on purpose: on the expanded card every row's action bar is already open, so a hover frame is indistinguishable from the resting one.
